description: Oracle NVL used in a PostgreSQL query (should be COALESCE)

input.sql: SELECT id, NVL(status, 'new') AS status FROM orders WHERE customer_id = $1

expectedDiagnostics.messageContains: Oracle NVL() used in PostgreSQL context. Use COALESCE()

notes: The PostgreSQL adapter reports NVL once (PG002; the dedicated NVL() pattern supersedes the keyword list) and the shared Oracle-leak rule (DG010) names PostgreSQL, the context provider, as the migration target.
